# Lawrenze Maranan

> Full-Stack & AI Engineer. Eight years building software, and now the AI that runs inside it. Remote, from the Philippines. Open to full-stack and AI engineering roles.

I'm Lawrenze Maranan, a full-stack and AI engineer with eight years of building reliable, user-focused applications.

Most of my backend work is in PHP frameworks; on the front end, modern JavaScript. Lately it is agents: orchestration, tools, evaluation, and keeping them honest in production.

## Case studies

- [LawStack aiops](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#aiops): An operator console that takes Jira tickets to pull requests, one AI agent per lane. 100+ tickets taken to a pull request; < 1 hr typical ticket to PR, down from hours; Daily still the way we work.
- [VIPTutors AI Suite](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#viptutors): AI learning apps for speech practice, interview prep and writing, with payments and live tutoring. 3 AI learning apps; < 6 mo built end to end; 1 platform for accounts, payments and tutoring.
- [MultiPortal](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#multiportal): A multi-tenant cloud platform where service providers run servers, networks and backups for their customers. One standard across the product; Any theme, light or dark; Every change checked automatically.

## Other work

- [Max](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#max): An AI team member for an MSP: an agent that works across chat channels with real tools.
- [Porto](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#porto): A company assistant that answers questions about the product and its docs.
- [ORKESTRA](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#orkestra): A console for a team of single-purpose agents, starting with support triage, where a person approves anything risky.
- [Hosted Network Tools](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#hostednetwork): Tools for managed service providers: service qualification and telco integrations.
- [Freelance builds](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#freelance): A patient management system, a dental clinic platform, e-commerce and a therapy booking app.
- [TestHub](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#testhub): An end-to-end testing platform: environments, runs and evidence.
- [LawStack verdict](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#verdict): Test results in one place: run history, flaky tests, screenshots and traces.
- [UI kit](https://lawrenzem.space/plain/#uikit): A themeable design system: customer brand colours, dark mode and translations.

## Experience, oldest first

- 2018: Bats. City Gov ITSD / IM Digital, IT on-the-job training. PC diagnostics, LAN and VLAN set-up, and web development fundamentals.
- 2018: Club Galaxy Boracay, Graphic Designer. Social campaigns and promotional visuals for LED displays and print.
- 2018: Freelance, Full Stack Developer. A patient management system, a dental clinic platform, e-commerce and a therapy booking app.
- 2019: Wiflab, Full Stack Developer. E-commerce, payroll and government systems in Laravel, CodeIgniter and PHP; Android and Flutter apps.
- 2021: Cognitif Incorporated, QA Engineer. End-to-end testing with Selenium and xUnit; GitLab CI/CD; Power BI reporting.
- 2023: VIPTutors Co., Mid Full Stack Engineer. AI learning apps with OpenAI and SpeechSuper; Stripe payments and Zoom tutoring.
- Now: Hosted Network, Full-Stack & AI Engineer. Internal tools for managed service providers: internet service qualification, telco integrations, and Max, an AI team member.
- Now: MultiPortal, Full-Stack & AI Engineer. A multi-tenant cloud platform: product features end to end, the design system behind every screen, and the team's AI tools.
